is: The zaf library and its thin binary: domain types, port traits, one use case per verb, live adapters with in-memory fakes, the ZAF.toml model, a single composition root and the command line.
conventions: Layers inner to outer: domain, ports, app, adapters; app sees only port traits and never names an adapter
composition.rs alone reads the manifest and picks adapters, returning each port as a boxed trait object or CompositionError::Absent
A module x lives in x.rs with its children in x/; a few use x/mod.rs instead (app ask, asklog, brief, check, profile, spawn)
Unit tests sit in x/tests.rs behind #[cfg(test)] mod tests, so many folders hold only tests.rs
Plain text newtypes use the text_newtype! macro from newtype.rs; a value with a rule gets a hand-written parser in its own module

fs.name: fakes/
fs.role: in-memory fake per port (board, design, forge, gate, vcs; the runner replays recorded output)

notes: Actual imports: domain uses no other layer; ports use domain plus manifest::CommandLine; app uses domain, ports, manifest and two composition constants
domain, ports, fakes and manifest keep their submodules private and re-export a flat API; adapters, app and cli expose pub mod
All runtime state goes under the project's git-ignored .zaf/: runs/, profiles/, roles/, slices/, spawn.state, guard.json, asklog.jsonl, local.toml
